item.text:
Further refactoring is in place.

What changed:
- Split the code into three top-level classes:
  - [BipartiteGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteGraph.java) as the facade and demo entry point
  - [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/Graph.java) as the immutable graph model and builder
  - [BipartiteChecker.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/BipartiteChecker.java) as the BFS coloring algorithm
- Removed the nested `Graph` helper from the main class.
- Kept the original `isBipartite(int, int[][])` API intact by delegating through the new graph model.
- Made the adjacency lists immutable with `List.copyOf(...)` after construction.

Verification:
- `javac BipartiteGraph.java Graph.java BipartiteChecker.java`
- `java BipartiteGraph`

The old monolithic source file [bipartite_graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/028_bipartite_graph/bipartite_graph.java) has been removed as part of the split.

1. Adding a small test suite for bipartite and non-bipartite cases.
2. Turning the checker into a reusable public API and moving the demo `main` into a separate runner.
